text: そうかい　それじゃ　また　きておくれ

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: ておくれ is a soft, old-fashioned way to say てくれ, which asks someone to do something for you. きておくれ = 'do come'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a soft, friendly か used by older speakers for questions. そうかい = 'is that so?'.
